name: jev
description: Jev picks the right GPT model and reasoning effort for every Codex task, from published benchmarks.

interface.shortDescription: Model and effort recommendation before every task.
interface.longDescription: Type `#jev an` once in a conversation. Jev classifies each new task (coding, agentic, reasoning, research, simple; easy/normal/hard) and a fixed policy picks the model from published benchmarks. Messages pass immediately when the current model fits; a clear quality gap (4+ benchmark points) or a 25%+ saving holds the message once with a recommendation. Send it again to proceed. `#jev`, `#jev <task>`, `#jev? <question>`, `#jev aus`. Requires AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY (Vercel AI Gateway); chat excerpts are sent to Jev and may incur charges.
